Datacurve has raised a $15M Series A to provide frontier training data to the world’s leading foundation-model labs, helping to push the boundaries of what AI can do. Instead of traditional data labeling, Datacurve uses a “bounty system” where skilled engineers contribute to hard-to-source datasets and get paid — over $1M in bounties so far. But co-founder Serena Ge says the real advantage is treating contributors like users, not contractors, creating a platform people actually want to use. As AI models shift from simple datasets to complex RL environments, demand for high-quality post-training data is exploding. Datacurve believes its approach could extend beyond software engineering to fields like finance, marketing, and even medicine. Congrats on the round, Serena, Charley Lee , and team! https://lnkd.in/gPhQnh4a ...more ...more

Today we’re announcing we’ve raised $17.7 million in funding across a $15M Series A led by Chemistry and a $2.7M Seed to accelerate foundation model progress through providing frontier training data for LLMs. When we first started Datacurve, it came from a simple realization: foundation model progress is limited not just by compute, but by data quality and complexity. The right data unlocks new capabilities, especially in coding, where accuracy and reasoning matter most. We’re now proud to partner with the world’s leading foundation-model labs, providing them with high-quality, complex training data that helps push the boundaries of what AI can do. This is still just the start. Come build the future of technology with us in San Francisco Huge thanks to our incredible team and investors who’ve believed in us since day one and beyond: Garry Tan at Y Combinator , Ivan Zhang from Cohere , Mark Goldberg from Chemistry , Derrick Li from Afore Capital , Umesh Khanna , Soheil Koushan , and Shyamal Hitesh Anadkat . ...more

Gemini 3.6 Flash is live! ⚡ As we continue to push the boundaries of what our models can achieve, a major focus has been advancing their agentic capabilities. I am incredibly proud to lead our post-training research efforts to significantly scale our ML research capabilities for this release. One of the standout results of this work is our massive performance jump on MLE-bench. ​Lately, a recurring frustration in the AI research community has been the friction introduced by overly aggressive system guardrails, particularly when operating in LLM codebases. ​We took a different approach. We built Gemini 3.6 Flash to lean into this complexity rather than shy away from it. It is designed to be a true accelerator for your work, delivering best-in-class performance at this price point for automating ML workflows without the artificial roadblocks. I highly encourage developers and researchers to jump into Antigravity, test it on your toughest repos, and start building your auto-research pipelines today! ​A huge congratulations to the entire team on this milestone! Let's keep building. 🚀 #gemini #google #deepmind #antigravity
